# synology_package_center (Resource)

Package Center update-channel, notification and automatic-update policy. Package installations and running state have separate owners. Import preserves current settings; destroy releases management without disabling updates. Trust is observed only because this DSM UI does not establish a corresponding setter. Automatic updates can change software and application data later; an enabled policy does not wait for those future operations.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_package_center.nas
  id = "package_center"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_package_center" "nas" {
  enabled             = false
  beta_channel        = false
  dsm_notifications   = true
  email_notifications = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `beta_channel` (Boolean) Enable the beta update channel in Package Center.
- `dsm_notifications` (Boolean) Show package notifications in DSM.
- `email_notifications` (Boolean) Send package notifications by email. Requires an existing DSM mail configuration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable automatic package updates.
- `important_only` (Boolean) Automatically install important updates for all eligible packages.
- `important_packages` (Set of String) Complete selected set for important updates in enabled custom mode. Must be disjoint from packages.
- `packages` (Set of String) Complete selected set for all updates in enabled custom mode. Omit outside custom mode; observed membership remains readable.
- `update_all` (Boolean) Automatically install all package updates. Mutually exclusive with important_only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: package_center. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
- `mail_configured` (Boolean) DSM reports an existing mail setup. SMTP configuration is not changed here.
- `trust_level` (Number) Observed legacy package trust-level value. No trust or signature override is performed.
